title: Inspecting Illumination
source_topic: ICPC / The 2019 Asia Danang Regional Contest
statement: A butler faces switches, each controlling exactly one of an equal number of light sources, but the pairing is unknown. In one round he may flip any non-empty set of switches and is then told, in arbitrary order, which sources changed state. With up to a thousand switches and at most thirty-two rounds allowed, he must report which switch drives each source.
